description: GIVEN one root config whose rootTranslationsPath is in project a of a multi-project workspace WHEN the keys of project b are searched THEN find reads the default folder of b, as extract writes to it, finds nothing missing and says so on stderr
stderrMatches: The translations folder of the config, <cwd>/projects/a/public/i18n/?, is outside project b \(projects/b\)\. Reading <cwd>/projects/b/src/assets/i18n instead\.
